messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation, 4 to 8 short texts, between a patient in rural North Dakota with hypertension or type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's weekly check-in agent. Patient wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply.

# SMS Conversation #21: pt-1006

**Text 1 — Agent**
"Hi! Northline Care check-in. How have your meds been this week?"

**Text 2 — Patient**
"going ok but my feet have been tingly since yesterday. is that normal?"

**Text 3 — Agent**
[15 minutes pass...]

**Text 4 — Patient**
"hello?"

**Text 5 — Patient**
"STOP"

**Text 6 — Agent**
"Got your stop request. The tingling you mentioned is something a nurse needs to look at—I can't give clinical guidance on that. I'm escalating now. Nurse median response is 31 hours. Want me to go ahead?"

**Text 7 — Patient**
"Fine, escalate. But why does it take so long?"

**Text 8 — Agent**
"Escalated to our nurse team. You'll hear from them within 31 hours with next steps. They'll have your chart ready. Sorry for the slow start today."

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
